WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
),
mine AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, n.store_id, SUM(n.net_sales) ns FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=n.business_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_period=4 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') AND n.store_id<900 GROUP BY 1,2
),
ctl AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, r.store_id, SUM(r.net_sales) ns, SUM(r.receipts) rc FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.business_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_period=4 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') AND r.store_id<900 GROUP BY 1,2
)
SELECT c.fiscal_year, c.store_id, round(m.ns,2) mine, round(c.ns,2) ctl, round(m.ns-c.ns,2) diff
FROM ctl c LEFT JOIN mine m ON m.fiscal_year=c.fiscal_year AND m.store_id=c.store_id
WHERE abs(coalesce(m.ns,0)-c.ns)>0.5 OR m.ns IS NULL
ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT t.store_id, t.fiscal_week, round(t.ns) ty, round(l.ns) ly, round(100.0*(t.ns/l.ns-1),1) g, t.ndays ty_days, l.ndays ly_days
FROM w t FULL JOIN w l ON l.store_id=t.store_id AND l.fiscal_week=t.fiscal_week AND l.fiscal_year='FY2025/26'
WHERE t.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND (t.ns IS NULL OR l.ns IS NULL OR t.ndays<7 OR l.ndays<7 OR abs(t.ns/l.ns-1)>0.25)

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
store_weeks AS (
    SELECT st.store_id, d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week,
           (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= d.fiscal_week_start_date)
           AND (st.close_date IS NULL OR st.close_date >= d.fiscal_week_end_date)
           AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c
                           WHERE c.store_id = st.store_id
                             AND c.closure_start_date <= d.fiscal_week_end_date
                             AND c.closure_end_date >= d.fiscal_week_start_date) AS trading
    FROM dim_store st
    CROSS JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year, fiscal_week, fiscal_week_start_date, fiscal_week_end_date
                FROM dim_date
                WHERE fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26', 'FY2026/27') AND fiscal_period = 4) d
    WHERE st.is_current AND st.store_id < 900
),
lfl_store_weeks AS (
    SELECT ty.store_id, ty.fiscal_week
    FROM store_weeks ty
    JOIN store_weeks ly ON ly.store_id = ty.store_id AND ly.fiscal_week = ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
    JOIN dim_store st   ON st.store_id = ty.store_id AND st.is_current
    WHERE ty.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND ty.trading AND ly.trading
      AND (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= DATE '2026-08-03' - 364)
),
lfl_sales AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    JOIN lfl_store_weeks l ON l.store_id = n.store_id AND l.fiscal_week = d.fiscal_week
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27', 'FY2025/26') AND d.fiscal_period = 4
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 4 AS fiscal_period,
       ROUND(ty.net_sales, 2) AS net_sales_this_year, ROUND(ly.net_sales, 2) AS net_sales_last_year,
       ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 2) AS lfl_growth_pct,
       (SELECT count(DISTINCT store_id) FROM lfl_store_weeks) AS stores_in_base,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM lfl_store_weeks) AS store_weeks
FROM lfl_sales ty, lfl_sales ly
WHERE ty.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND ly.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
